characters.name: Elizabeth Bennet
characters.description: Second Bennet daughter; intelligent, witty heroine who narratively resists social pressures and later re-evaluates Mr. Darcy.

characters.name: Jane Bennet
characters.description: Eldest Bennet daughter; gentle, reserved, and kind-hearted, admired by Mr. Bingley.

characters.name: Mr. Bennet
characters.description: Owner of Longbourn; father of the Bennet sisters, sardonic and reserved.

characters.name: Mrs. Bennet
characters.description: Mother of the Bennet sisters; chiefly concerned with marrying off her daughters.

characters.name: Lydia Bennet
characters.description: Youngest Bennet sister; frivolous, flirtatious, impulsive and the one who elopes with Wickham.

characters.name: Catherine (Kitty) Bennet
characters.description: Third Bennet daughter commonly called Kitty; younger sister often influenced by Lydia.

characters.name: Mary Bennet
characters.description: Middle Bennet daughter; bookish and moralizing.

characters.name: Charles Bingley
characters.description: Wealthy, good-humoured gentleman who rents Netherfield; Jane’s principal suitor.

characters.name: Caroline Bingley
characters.description: Mr. Bingley’s sister; fashionable, jealous of Elizabeth and disposed to promote Miss Darcy.

characters.name: Mr. Darcy
characters.description: Wealthy gentleman of Pemberley; reserved and proud but capable of deep feeling and decisive action.

characters.name: Georgiana Darcy
characters.description: Mr. Darcy’s shy and accomplished younger sister.

characters.name: Colonel Fitzwilliam
characters.description: Mr. Darcy’s amiable cousin; pleasant, well-bred officer.

characters.name: Mr. Wickham
characters.description: A militia officer whose agreeable manners hide improvidence and moral failings; elopes with Lydia.

characters.name: Mr. Collins
characters.description: Obsequious clergyman and heir presumptive to Longbourn; officious, pompous, and self-important.

characters.name: Lady Catherine de Bourgh
characters.description: Proud, overbearing noblewoman; patroness of Mr. Collins and motherly guardian figure to Miss de Bourgh.

characters.name: Miss de Bourgh
characters.description: Lady Catherine’s sickly daughter (intended by Lady Catherine as Mr. Darcy’s match).

characters.name: Sir William Lucas
characters.description: Former tradesman turned local gentleman of Lucas Lodge; neighbor of the Bennets.

characters.name: Lady Lucas
characters.description: Sir William Lucas’s wife; neighbor and friend of Mrs. Bennet.

characters.name: Charlotte Lucas
characters.description: Friend of Elizabeth; sensible, pragmatic woman who marries Mr. Collins for security.

characters.name: Mrs. Phillips
characters.description: Mrs. Bennet’s sister-in-law in Meryton who keeps the family informed of local news.

characters.name: Sir Lewis de Bourgh
characters.description: Deceased husband of Lady Catherine (referenced); part of Lady Catherine’s background, mentioned in narrative.

characters.name: Mrs. Hurst
characters.description: Mrs. Bingley’s sister; fashionable and superficial woman.

characters.name: Mr. Hurst
characters.description: Mrs. Hurst’s husband; idle gentleman.

characters.name: Bingley party (Mr. Bingley’s sisters/relatives)
characters.description: The group of sisters and relatives who accompany Mr. Bingley (notably Caroline and Mrs. Hurst).

characters.name: Mrs. Long
characters.description: Local acquaintance who provides neighborhood intelligence (mentioned as introducing Mr. Bingley).

characters.name: Mr. Denny
characters.description: An officer of the ----shire regiment; acquaintance of Wickham and others.

characters.name: Colonel Forster
characters.description: Colonel of the ----shire militia; acquaintance of the Bennets and Lydia’s commanding officer.

characters.name: Captain Carter
characters.description: An officer in the militia mentioned as an object of Lydia’s early admiration.

characters.name: Pratt
characters.description: An officer mentioned among the militia and social circle in Meryton.

characters.name: Mrs. Gardiner
characters.description: Mrs. Bennet’s sister; sensible, kind, and a close friend to Jane and Elizabeth; travels with her husband.

characters.name: Mr. Gardiner
characters.description: Mrs. Gardiner’s husband; sensible, practical, and helpful in the search for Lydia.

characters.name: Mrs. Gardiner's children
characters.description: The Gardiners’ four children (two girls and two younger boys) who travel with their aunt and uncle.

aliases.text: two girls of six and eight years old

characters.name: Mrs. Hill
characters.description: Servant/housemaid at Longbourn who brings news and assists the Bennet household.

characters.name: Mrs. Reynolds
characters.description: Housekeeper at Pemberley who provides information about the Darcy household and its reputation.

characters.name: Mrs. Jenkinson
characters.description: Lady Catherine’s companion and attendant at Rosings.

characters.name: Mrs. Annesley
characters.description: A genteel woman connected to the Pemberley household who converses with visitors there.

characters.name: Mr. Jones
characters.description: The apothecary called in to see Jane when she falls ill at Netherfield.

characters.name: Mr. Morris
characters.description: Agent/owner’s representative at Netherfield mentioned regarding the letting of the house.

characters.name: Mr. Robinson
characters.description: Neighbor who converses about the assembly and Mr. Bingley (appears in overheard remarks).

characters.name: Mr. Haggerston
characters.description: Solicitor or agent referenced by Mr. Gardiner as handling settlement details for Lydia (mentioned in correspondence).

characters.name: Elizabeth Bennet
characters.description: Second Bennet daughter; principal protagonist who becomes Mr. Darcy’s wife; sister of Jane, Mary, Kitty (Catherine), and Lydia.

characters.name: Jane Bennet
characters.description: Eldest Bennet daughter; amiable, engaged to Mr. Bingley.

characters.name: Mr. Bingley
characters.description: A wealthy, amiable gentleman; close friend of Mr. Darcy and suitor/fiance of Jane Bennet.

characters.name: Mr. Darcy
characters.description: A wealthy gentleman of Pemberley; friend of Mr. Bingley; later Elizabeth’s husband.

characters.name: Mrs. Bennet
characters.description: Matron of Longbourn; mother of the Bennet daughters, eager to secure advantageous marriages for them.

characters.name: Mr. Bennet
characters.description: Owner of Longbourn; father of the Bennet daughters, noted for his dry humour.

characters.name: Kitty Bennet
characters.description: Catherine ‘Kitty’ Bennet; one of the middle Bennet daughters, sometimes called Catherine.

characters.name: Mary Bennet
characters.description: One of the Bennet daughters given to moralizing and accomplishments.

characters.name: Lydia Wickham
characters.description: Youngest Bennet daughter who marries Mr. Wickham; vivacious and imprudent.

characters.name: Mr. Wickham
characters.description: Officer in the militia; marries Lydia; previously involved in disputes with Mr. Darcy.

characters.name: Lady Catherine de Bourgh
characters.description: A titled, imperious noblewoman of Rosings; aunt of Mr. Darcy and a principal antagonist to Elizabeth’s match with him.

characters.name: Miss de Bourgh
characters.description: Lady Catherine’s daughter (referred to in Lady Catherine’s remarks as the expected match for Mr. Darcy).

characters.name: Mr. Collins
characters.description: A clergyman and cousin to the Bennets; officious, the husband of Charlotte Collins.

characters.name: Charlotte Collins
characters.description: Mrs. Collins (née Charlotte); friend of Elizabeth who married Mr. Collins.

characters.name: Sir William Lucas
characters.description: A local baronet and neighbour (head of the Lucas family).

characters.name: Mrs. Long
characters.description: A local acquaintance mentioned among visitors and commentators on the Bennet family.

characters.name: Mrs. Philips
characters.description: A neighbour and relation who visits the Bennets; noted for vulgarity in the narrative.

characters.name: Mrs. Gardiner
characters.description: Elizabeth’s aunt; attentive and practical relative.

characters.name: Mr. Gardiner
characters.description: Elizabeth’s uncle; mentioned together as the Gardiners.

characters.name: Georgiana Darcy
characters.description: Mr. Darcy’s shy younger sister, cultivated and residing at Pemberley.

characters.name: Miss Bingley (Caroline Bingley)
characters.description: Caroline Bingley; sister of Mr. Bingley and a social rival to Elizabeth.

characters.name: Maria (Lucas niece)
characters.description: One of the Lucases’ nieces (a member of the Lucas household whom Kitty wishes to visit).
